item.description: There’s a special satisfaction in seeing your own thoughts summarized in a single sentence by a stranger online. These posts manage to do that repeatedly, turning common experiences into jokes that land because they feel less like exaggeration and more like confession.

item.title: 36 Moments People Realized They No Longer Wanted To Work At Their Current Job And Quit
item.description: Dramatic exits, spontaneous decisions and many times, bridges burned without a care in the world. This is the stuff dreams are made of when you've reached the end of your rope at work. Rage quitting has become all the rage in recent years. People who have done it have been sharing their stories, and many might be worthy of a Netflix office drama series.

item.title: 77 Seriously Impressive Sculptures People Made With Their Own Hands
item.description: Sculpture is one of those art forms that demands real patience. A single piece can take hours, sometimes even hundreds, to dream up, plan out, and slowly build into something worth showing off. There’s no rushing the details, and that’s exactly what makes the results so satisfying to look at. To celebrate that kind of skill and dedication, we’ve rounded up some seriously stunning works people made and shared on the Sculpture subreddit. Show them some love.

item.title: Family Decides To Forgive Man For Beating His Brother 5 Years Ago, He Doesn’t Like Their Tone
item.description: We’re supposed to love our family members more than anyone else on the planet. But sometimes, people have to admit that they’re better off without their relatives than with them. That’s why one man wasn’t upset about being estranged from his parents and siblings for the past five years. But now, all of a sudden, they’re pressuring him to become a part of their lives again.

item.title: 52 Stories About Betrayals That Ended The Longest Friendships People Had
item.description: We’re taught how to cut off ties with a romantic partner if things don’t work out, but there’s really no script or rulebook when a friendship starts to crack. Most of us are familiar with the red flags in a romantic relationship, and it often assumed that friendships are easier. But even platonic relationships take work, and when one person stops putting in the effort, it can quickly turn toxic.
